title: RunConfig
description: Input contract for a single benchmark run. Engine-neutral: both the Spark and Flink jars read this exact shape via their own parser. Mirrors clustering.benchmark.config.RunConfig (Scala). 'engineConf' is the neutral name; the Spark jar currently reads/writes it as 'sparkConf' (both accepted - see contract/README.md).

runId.description: Globally unique id; becomes the result filename stem (<runId>.json).

profile.description: Cluster profile. If absent, the engine auto-detects from env (e.g. SLURM_JOB_ID).

type.description: DataSource type, e.g. 'synthetic' | 'parquet' | 'csv'. Resolved by each engine's DataSource registry.

params.description: Free-form source params (e.g. numPoints, numPartitions, seed, path). Each engine parses what it needs.

name.description: Algorithm name, e.g. 'kmeans' | 'pam' | 'fastpam' | 'clara' | 'dbscan' | 'griddbscan'. Resolved by each engine's algorithm registry.

params.description: Free-form algorithm params (e.g. k, maxIter, distance, eps, minPts, seed).

sampleSize.description: Optional cap for O(n^2) metrics like silhouette. null/absent = full dataset.

seed.description: RNG seed for evaluation sampling. Defaults to 42 in the engine if absent.

engineConf.description: Extra engine configuration entries set before session start (Spark: SparkConf; Flink: execution config). Neutral name.

sparkConf.description: DEPRECATED alias of engineConf, accepted by the Spark jar. Prefer engineConf for new configs.

outputDir.description: Overrides the profile's default output directory when present.

experimentMetadata.description: Free-form key->value tags describing the experiment setup (nodes, cores, memory, walltime, module, ...). Written verbatim into the result for analysis.
